final: SELECT AVG(avg_pressratio) AS avg_group_pressratio, AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_group_gb_per_minute FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, z.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS z ON z.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, z.typesite)
